title: Powdered sugar for the sugar in a baked dough's dry mix

evidence.basis: B5, scoped to the dry mix of a baked dough. OD-7 (owner commission 2026-10-08, ENGINEERING only; not culinary validation, not released guidance). Evidence: private/research/substitution-knowledge (2026-10-07). ATK SRC-SU-11#a (powdered sugar should not be used for granulated in most recipes; contains cornstarch); KA SRC-SU-01#h, SRC-SU-01#g; Domino SRC-SU-20#a, SRC-SU-22#a (summarizer-only, corroboration). Not generalized to whipped cream, icings, other sugar forms or techniques.

text: Powdered (icing) sugar can't simply replace the sugar in this dough's dry mix: it's ground to a powder and contains starch, so it doesn't behave like crystal sugar in a baked dough.
scopeNote: This is about powdered sugar in this baked dough's dry mix only. Whipped cream, icings and recipes written for powdered sugar are different.
answer: doesn't behave like crystal sugar in this baked dough
